items.computation: The practice is located in Beispielwetzlar, postal code 35576 (Wetzlar), which is in Hessen, so Hessen public holidays apply here rather than NRW. 'Werktage' = Monday–Saturday, excluding public holidays. The appointment is Monday 14.12.2026 (this day itself is not counted as one of the 'Werktage vorher'). Counting backward: Saturday 12.12.2026 is the 1st Werktag before; Sunday 13.12.2026 is not a Werktag; Friday 11.12.2026 is the 2nd Werktag before. No public holiday (nationwide or Hessen-specific) falls between these dates, so no shift is needed. Therefore notice of cancellation must reach the practice by Friday, 11.12.2026 at the latest.
